faq_q1.message: Menene ApplyFlow kuma ta yaya yake aiki?

faq_a1.message: ApplyFlow wani tsawo ne na Chrome mai ƙarfin AI wanda ke ganowa da kuma cike fom ɗin aikace-aikacen aiki a cikin dandamali 15+ da suka haɗa da LinkedIn, Internshala, Unstop, Ranar Aiki, Greenhouse, Lever, da ƙari. Yana karanta bayanan martaba da aka adana kuma yana amfani da madaidaicin madaidaici don cike filayen rubutu, zazzagewa, maɓallin rediyo, da akwatunan rajistan shiga - gami da EEO/tambayoyin alƙaluma.

faq_q2.message: Shin bayanan sirri na yana lafiya tare da ApplyFlow?

faq_a2.message: Ee. Ana adana bayanan ku a gida a cikin chrome.storage.local na burauzar ku ta tsohuwa. Ba a taɓa aikawa zuwa kowane uwar garken ɓangare na uku ba in ban da bayanan Supabase na zaɓi na zaɓi (wanda kuke sarrafawa). ApplyFlow baya siyarwa, rabawa, ko yin monetize bayanan keɓaɓɓen ku.

faq_q3.message: Wadanne hanyoyin aiki ne ApplyFlow ke tallafawa?

faq_a3.message: ApplyFlow yana goyan bayan dandamali 15+ daga cikin akwatin: LinkedIn Easy Aiwatar, Internshala, Unstop, Ranar Aiki, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, Jobvite, Taleo, Naukri, Hakika, Wellfound/AngelList, da kowane rukunin yanar gizon mu ta hanyar mashigin faɗuwar gabaɗaya.

faq_a4.message: Maɓallin Yanar Gizon maɓalli ne mai iyo "Ajiye Ayuba" (📌) wanda ke bayyana kai tsaye lokacin da kuka ziyarci kowane shafi na jerin ayyuka. Danna shi yana fitar da taken aiki, kamfani, albashi, da kwatancin, sannan adana shi zuwa mai bin sawun ku na ApplyFlow azaman aikace-aikacen "Ajiye" - don haka zaku iya bin ayyukan yi kafin amfani.

faq_q5.message: Ta yaya zan sabunta bayanin martaba na?

faq_a5.message: Bude popup na ApplyFlow, danna maballin "Profile", sannan loda ci gaba na PDF. AI za ta cika dukkan filayen ku ta atomatik. Hakanan zaka iya shirya kowane filin da hannu gami da abubuwan da kake so na EEO, izinin aiki, da haruffan murfi.

faq_q6.message: Menene filayen EEO kuma me yasa nake buƙatar su?

faq_a6.message: Filin EEO (Damar Aiki Daidaita Daidai) tambayoyi ne da yawancin Amurkawa da ma'aikata na duniya suke tambaya game da jinsi, matsayin nakasa, matsayin tsohon soja, da izinin aiki. ApplyFlow yana adana amsoshin da kuka fi so kuma ta cika waɗannan rukunin maɓallin rediyo ta atomatik don kada ku amsa su da hannu kowane lokaci.

faq_q7.message: Shin ApplyFlow yana buƙatar kowane maɓallan API ko tsari?

faq_a7.message: A'a! ApplyFlow yana sarrafa duk gano nau'i, daidaitawa mai wayo, ƙirƙirar haruffa, da ƙima mai dacewa ta atomatik. Ba kwa buƙatar samun ko saita kowane maɓallan API.

faq_q8.message: Menene Supabase sync kuma ina bukatan shi?

faq_a8.message: Supabase sync shine fasalin madadin girgije na zaɓi. Lokacin da ka shiga tare da Google kuma ka kunna shi, bayanan martaba da mai sa ido na aikace-aikacen ana daidaita su zuwa bayanan girgije mai zaman kansa don haka bayananka suna samun tallafi da samun dama daga na'urori da yawa. Wannan cikakken zaɓi ne - tsawo yana aiki gabaɗaya a layi.

faq_q9.message: Me yasa ApplyFlow ke buƙatar samun dama ga duk gidajen yanar gizo?

faq_a9.message: ApplyFlow yana buƙatar samun dama ga duk gidajen yanar gizo don ta iya yin allurar injin cikawa ta atomatik akan kowane fom ɗin aikace-aikacen aiki, kuma ya nuna maɓallin "Ajiye Ayuba" akan kowane jerin ayyuka. Ana buƙatar wannan izini don tallafin dandamali mai faɗi. Mu kawai allurar rubutun akan shafukan da ke da alaƙa da aiki a sarari.

faq_a10.message: Hukumar Kanban kallon aikin gani ne a cikin shafin Tracker. Yana nuna aikace-aikacen ku da aka tsara a cikin ginshiƙai: Ajiye → Aiwatar da → Kima → Hira → Bayar. Kuna iya ja da sauke katunan tsakanin ginshiƙai don sabunta matsayin kowane aikace-aikacen.

faq_a11.message: Lokacin da kuka kunna "Log kawai bayan ƙaddamarwa" a cikin saitunan, ApplyFlow yana kallon canje-canjen shafi wanda ke nuna nasarar ƙaddamarwa (kamar URL mai ɗauke da "/ nasara" ko rubutun jiki yana cewa "Na gode da nema"). Yana shigar da aikace-aikacen zuwa mai sa ido kawai bayan ya gano ainihin ƙaddamarwa.

faq_q12.message: Zan iya adana haruffan murfi da yawa?

faq_a12.message: Ee! Allon bayanin martaba yana da sashin "Cover Letter Vault" inda zaku iya adana haruffan murfin mara iyaka waɗanda aka keɓance da ayyuka ko kamfanoni daban-daban. Lokacin cikawa ta atomatik, ApplyFlow zai yi amfani da wasiƙar murfin ku na baya-bayan nan ko mafi dacewa.

faq_q13.message: Ta yaya zan fitar da bayanan aikace-aikace na?

faq_a13.message: Je zuwa Account & Daidaitawa → gungura zuwa ƙasa → danna "Ajiyayyen Ajiye (JSON)". Wannan yana zazzage duk bayanan martaba da aikace-aikacenku azaman fayil ɗin JSON don kiyayewa.

faq_q14.message: Shin ApplyFlow yana aiki a Yanayin Demo?

faq_a14.message: Yanayin Demo wani saitin gado ne da aka yi amfani da shi don gwaji. Yanzu an kashe shi ta tsohuwa. Duk fasalulluka suna raye kuma suna aiki tare da ginanniyar maɓallin API na Gemini.

faq_q15.message: Ta yaya zan ba da rahoton bug ko neman fasali?

faq_a15.message: Da fatan za a buɗe batun akan ma'ajiyar mu ta GitHub (wanda ke da alaƙa a cikin Game da sashe) ko yi mana imel a support@applyflow.in. Mu yawanci muna amsawa cikin sa'o'i 48.

privacy_policy_content.message:
** Aiwatar da Tsawaita Tafiya Chrome - Manufar Keɓantawa ***
An sabunta ta ƙarshe: Yuni 2026

--_NL_3__
**1. Gabatarwa**

ApplyFlow ("we", "namu", "The Extension") tsawo ne na burauzar Chrome wanda ke taimaka wa masu amfani su cika fom ɗin aikace-aikacen kai tsaye, bin aikace-aikacen su, da sarrafa bayanan ƙwararrun su. Wannan Dokar Sirri tana bayanin yadda muke tattarawa, amfani, adana, da kare bayananku.

Ta hanyar shigar da amfani da ApplyFlow, kun yarda da ayyukan da aka bayyana a cikin wannan tsarin. Bayanan da Muka Tattara**

Muna tattara bayanan da kuka bayar da son rai kawai don ba da damar fasalulluka na tsawaitawa:

• **Bayanin Bayanan Bayanai**: Sunanku, imel, lambar waya, koleji, digiri, ƙwarewa, tarihin aiki, ayyukan, da hanyoyin haɗin gwiwar ƙwararru (LinkedIn, GitHub, Fayil ɗin Fayil **) . (Na zaɓi)**: Jinsi, matsayin nakasa, matsayin tsohon soja, da zaɓin izinin aiki - ana bayar da shi kawai idan kun zaɓi cika waɗannan filayen. Ana amfani da wannan bayanan ne kawai don cika takaddun tambayoyin EEO na zaɓi akan aikace-aikacen aiki.
• ** Bayanan Bibiyar Aikace-aikacen**: Sunan aiki, kamfani, URL ɗin aikace-aikacen, matsayi, da bayanin kula don matsayi da kuke waƙa ta hanyar amfani da tsawo. Idan kun zaɓi shiga tare da Google, muna adana sunan Google nuni, adireshin imel, da URL ɗin hoton bayanin martaba don keɓance kwarewarku da ba da damar daidaitawa ga girgije. bayanai daga shafuka lokacin da ba a kunna tsawaita aiki ba

--

**3. Yadda Muke Ajiye Bayananku**

**3.1 Ma'ajiyar Gida (Tsoffin)**
Dukkan bayanan ana adana su ne a cikin chrome.storage.local API. Wannan bayanan yana kan na'urar ku kawai kuma ba a taɓa watsa shi zuwa kowane sabar ba tare da takamaiman aikinku ba. Kuna riƙe cikakken ikon wannan bayanan. Kuna iya share shi a kowane lokaci daga sashin Asusu & Daidaitawa.

**3.3 Gemini AI Buƙatun**
Lokacin da aka yi amfani da fasalulluka na AI (misali, tsara rubutun, nazarin aiki), sassan bayanin martaba (ƙwarewa, digiri, taƙaitawa) da kuma bayanin bayanin bayanin aikin ana aika zuwa Google's Gemini API. Ana sarrafa wannan a ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin API na Google's Sharuɗɗan Sabis da Manufar Keɓantawa. Muna ba da shawarar kar a haɗa abubuwan gano sirri na sirri a cikin abun ciki na taimakon AI.

--

**4. Rarraba Data**
